Direkt, unternehmerisch und ohne juristische Floskeln. Um unser Wachstum weiter voranzutreiben, suchen wir eine engagierte Person für die Stelle als People & Operations Associate (m/w/d). jobs.title: Junior Customer Operations (w/m/d) - Immobiliengutachten
jobs.description: Über Evalion & Gutachten(.)org Evalion ist eine digitale Plattform & ein Gutachtenbüro für hochwertige Immobiliengutachten. Mit unseren Marken Evalion(.)net (B2B) und Gutachten(.)org (B2C) schaffen wir einen einfachen Zugang zu professionellen Gutachten für Privatpersonen, Unternehmen und institutionelle Investoren - und bauen ein skalierbares Geschäftsmodell für den DACH-Markt auf. Langfristig entwickeln wir ein Service-Ökosystem rund um die Immobilie mit integrierten Angeboten für Eigentümer, Investoren und Unternehmen. Mit Evalion digitalisieren und revolutionalisieren wir eine systemrelevante Branche. Aufgaben Du betreust unsere Kund:innen rund um ihre Immobiliengutachten, vom Auftragseingang bis zur finalen Übergabe, als zentrale Ansprechperson per Telefon, E-Mail und Chat. Du holst Unterlagen ein, prüfst sie auf Vollständigkeit und klärst offene Fragen. Du koordinierst Besichtigungstermine zwischen Kund:innen und unseren Sachverständigen. Du bereitest Objektdaten strukturiert auf und wirkst an der Erstellung der Gutachten mit. Du sorgst dafür, dass alle Aufträge vollständig und fristgerecht bearbeitet werden. Du begleitest Interessent:innen im Vertrieb, fasst eigenständig nach und sorgst dafür, dass kein Auftrag verloren geht. Du vertrittst uns auf Community-Events wie Immocation-Stammtischen sowie auf Messen. This role is ideal for someone who has worked inside the loan file, understands where mortgages break, and is motivated to help build scalable, automated systems that eliminate those failures over time. jobs.title: Intern AI & Data Transformation
jobs.description: Mission Brief   Isar Aerospace is building Spectrum, a European launch vehicle. As an Intern in Data Engineering, you help bring engineering, manufacturing, business and operations data into one place, connecting sources to our emerging warehouse, building reliable data models and delivering dashboards that support company decisions.   Your Role in Our Space Mission:   Connect data sources. Integrate APIs, SaaS tools and databases into our warehouse using Python and dlt.   Build reliable pipelines. Develop and maintain scheduled ELT/ETL pipelines, monitor data quality and troubleshoot failures.   Create trusted data models. Clean and transform data with dbt into tested, documented models for team data products.   Build dashboards. Develop and maintain Metabase and Power BI dashboards for company KPIs.   Keep data understandable. Document sources, metrics and definitions so others can find and trust the data.   Work with stakeholders. Clarify requirements with data consumers and refine what you deliver.   Qualification Checklist   Education: Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s in computer science, data engineering or information systems; available for at least six months.   Experience: Initial hands-on experience with pipelines, data ingestion or analytics through an internship, working student role or personal projects.   Technical skills: Solid Python fundamentals and confident SQL, including joins, aggregations and relational schema basics.   Tools and learning: Basic REST API, JSON, authentication and Git knowledge; comfortable learning new tools and data sources from documentation.   Working style: Structured and detail-oriented, with a focus on accurate results and turning unclear requests into precise questions.   Languages: Fluent English and clear communication; German is an advantage.   Bonus Skills   Data stack: Experience with PostgreSQL, dlt, dbt, Metabase or Power BI.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
jobs.description: The role HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group s cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team. What you’ll do Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets. Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions. Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities. Report progress against the group s ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.   You are... An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership. Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineering Intern: System 1 Models for Reactive Space Operations
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains. Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios. Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station) Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027. About this role: Review the state of the art on System 1 / fast, intuitive models and compare them with the System 2 models used today, including our partners' models. Map where System 1 models could bring value in our operational chain for reactivity use cases, from detection to tasking. Define benchmark scenarios of increasing complexity with the team: a single-satellite reactive loop, then a two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue loop, and, as a stretch goal, a multi-satellite scenario. Set the latency budget, accuracy needs, and execution context for each scenario. Build datasets and evaluation sets from Loft data, partner outputs, and open datasets. Train or fine-tune System 1 models and benchmark them against System 2 baselines on reactivity (latency), performance (accuracy, compute footprint), and ease of use (integration and operational effort).
